categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in VOCs (Volatile Organic Compounds) pollution control systems for high-tech manufacturing processes, industrial dehumidification engineering, and related maintenance services. It also develops energy-saving systems, solvent recovery, and oil-gas recovery equipment, serving mainly semiconductor, petrochemical, and electronics industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include zeolite rotor adsorption-concentration, thermal oxidizers (including regenerative and catalytic types), rotary desiccant dehumidifiers, and hollow fiber membrane systems for chemical filtration and oil-gas recovery. The company integrates system design, manufacturing, installation, and maintenance with proprietary patented components and collaborates with academic and research institutions for R&D in fuel cells, green hydrogen vaporization, and nano-scale chemical filters.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are semiconductor foundries, high-tech electronics manufacturers, petrochemical plants, and emerging electric vehicle battery producers requiring stringent environmental controls. The company focuses on Taiwan's semiconductor sector and is expanding into printing, coating, and battery industries, as well as oil-gas recovery markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan with multiple offices and factories, including a manufacturing plant in Taoyuan and offices in Hsinchu, Taichung, Tainan, and Kaohsiung. The company also has subsidiaries in Shanghai, China, and plans to expand into Southeast Asia, specifically Singapore and Malaysia, to support regional market growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain, providing engineering design, manufacturing, installation, and maintenance services for pollution control and environmental systems. It acts as a system integrator and service provider rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening core system integration technologies, continuous innovation in VOCs pollution control, development of fuel cell and green hydrogen technologies, and nano-scale chemical filtration. The company emphasizes sustainable development aligned with net-zero emission goals, expanding product lines for energy and environmental air treatment, and enhancing automation and engineering talent cultivation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through engineering project contracts for pollution control system design and installation, ongoing maintenance and repair services, and sales of environmental equipment and components. The company also benefits from long-term service agreements and parts replacement, with a focus on domestic sales supplemented by exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in Taiwan's VOCs pollution control equipment market, holding over 90% market share in semiconductor-related VOCs systems. It is the exclusive Taiwan distributor for West Japan Tech, a global leader in VOC rotor technology, and competes with a few specialized domestic and international firms in environmental engineering and equipment manufacturing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.25 billion, a 7.55% increase from the prior year, with net profit growing 23.65% to NT$377 million. The company has shown steady growth supported by strong semiconductor industry demand and maintains a healthy financial structure with increasing retained earnings and equity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers comprehensive one-stop solutions integrating design, manufacturing, installation, and 24/7 maintenance services, backed by proprietary patented technologies and exclusive distribution rights for world-class VOC rotor products. Its deep expertise in semiconductor-grade pollution control, strong engineering capabilities, and commitment to sustainability and energy efficiency differentiate it from competitors.
